documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Update On The Scheme Of Amalgamation.

analysis.summary: MPS Limited reported its strongest first quarter in history for Q1 FY27, with reported revenue of INR 224.24 crores and EBITDA of INR 76.96 crores. Management reaffirmed its outlook to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA for FY27, viewing it as a floor rather than a ceiling. The company is experiencing structural margin expansion driven by operating leverage, a shift from effort-based to outcomes-based revenue, and the integration of acquisitions like Unbound Medicine. Across Research, Education, and Corporate Learning, AI is embedded directly into core delivery and revenue-generating workflows. MPS Limited reported its strongest opening quarter for Q1 FY27, achieving record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT alongside a Rule of 50 status.

guidance.claim: For FY28, the targets are approximately INR 1,500 crores in revenue and around INR 450 crores in EBITDA.
guidance.quote: So, to summarize: for FY’28, the targets are approximately INR 1,500 crores in revenue and around INR 450 crores in EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 EBITDA guidance to comfortably cross INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: FY27: TRACKING TO COMFORTBALY CROSS INR 300 CRORES IN EBITDA

guidance.claim: The company regards INR 300 Crores as an EBITDA mark it is positioned to clear comfortably.
guidance.quote: We continue to regard INR 300 Crores as a mark we are positioned to clear comfortably.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for the newly launched Pre-Submission Peer Review service has run well ahead of plan.
demand_outlook.quote: We launched Pre-Submission Peer Review in April, our first genuinely new service in more than two years, and demand has run well ahead of what we planned.

demand_outlook.claim: In Research Solutions, the demand for integrity and verification is rising sharply due to fake papers and AI-generated submissions.
demand_outlook.quote: The bottleneck in research today is no longer generation; it is verification. This positions us directly in the fastest-growing control points in the scholarly workflow.

demand_outlook.claim: Unbound Medicine brings a broad institutional base of medical schools, nursing schools, hospitals, and academic libraries with strong renewal economics.
demand_outlook.quote: Unbound brings a fundamentally different customer shape. It is a broad institutional base of medical schools, nursing schools, hospitals, and academic libraries. So many more accounts - smaller, but many more, and with very high renewal economics and low concentration risks.

capex_expansion.claim: The Unbound Medicine acquisition closed on February 9, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Third, the Unbound Medicine acquisition, which closed on February 9, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Reported revenue for the quarter was INR 224.24 crores, up 20.4 percent over the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Reported revenue for the quarter was INR 224.24 crores, up 20.4 percent over the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA was INR 76.96 crores, up 53.0 percent, with the EBITDA margin expanding to 34.3 percent.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR 76.96 crores, up 53.0 percent, with the EBITDA margin expanding to 34.3 percent from 27.0 percent a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 43.0 percent to INR 50.39 crores and basic EPS came in at INR 29.70.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 43.0 percent to INR 50.39 crores, and basic EPS came in at INR 29.70, an all-time Q1 high, up from INR 20.78.

margins_costs.claim: Research Solutions segment revenue was INR 123.23 crores, up 13.2 percent year over year, with EBITDA growing 37.9 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Segment revenue was INR 123.23 crores, up 13.2 percent year over year, and it remained the largest part of MPS at 55 percent of total revenue. What I would draw your attention to is the quality of that growth. EBITDA grew 37.9 percent, well ahead of revenue, and the segment margin widened to 45.1 percent.

margins_costs.claim: Education segment revenue grew 42.2 percent year over year to INR 73.41 crores at a 35.1 percent EBITDA margin.
margins_costs.quote: Segment revenue grew 42.2 percent year over year to INR 73.41 crores, and 22.1 percent over the prior quarter, at a 35.1 percent EBITDA margin.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding AJE, EBITDA margin expanded by 6.06 points YoY to 33.73%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 6.06 points to 33.73%

margins_costs.claim: Research segment achieved an EBITDA margin of 45.07% with AJE and 46.72% without AJE.
FY26 group EBITDA margin expanded to 30.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR 236 crores, up by 11.8%, with the EBITDA margin expanding to 30.7%.

margins_costs.claim: The Research segment EBITDA margin expanded 330 basis points to 39.9% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: The Research segment EBITDA margin expanded 330 basis points to 39.9% for the year, and Education delivered EBITDA growth of 42.6% year-over-year.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 EBITDA grew 20.5% to INR 67.5 crores with margins expanding to 32.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew 20.5% to INR 67.5 crores with the margins expanding to 32.9%, indicating operating leverage at work as revenue growth converted to margin expansion.

orders_capacity.claim: Q4 closed with the strongest order book of FY26 for the corporate learning business.
orders_capacity.quote: Q4 closed with the strongest order book of FY'26.

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 138.02 crores as of 30 June, against borrowings of INR 37.63 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Total cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 138.02 crores as of 30 June, against borrowings of INR 37.63 crores relating to the facility we drew for the Unbound Medicine acquisition.

capital_allocation.claim: DSO improved to 45 days from 51 at the end of March.
capital_allocation.quote: Collections stayed tight, with DSO improving to 45 days from 51 at the end of March.

capital_allocation.claim: Debtors DSO improved QoQ to 45 days from 51 days, reflecting enhanced collection efficiency and tighter working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: DSO improved QoQ to 45 days from 51 days, reflecting enhanced collection efficiency and tighter working capital management

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 113.75 crores as of 31 March 2026, with borrowings of INR 40.25 crores for the acquisition of Unbound Medicine.
capital_allocation.quote: On the balance sheet, total cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 113.75 crores as of 31 March 26, with borrowings of INR 40.25 crores relating to the facility drawn for the acquisition of Unbound Medicine.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has chosen not to recommend a final dividend for FY26 due to capital deployment into the Unbound Medicine acquisition and a hyperactive M&A pipeline.
capital_allocation.quote: Over FY’26, the Board has chosen not to recommend a final dividend. The reason is straightforward. We've deployed capital into the Unbound Medicine acquisition in February, we're carrying a hyperactive M&A pipeline, and the deployment opportunity in front of us exceeds the cash in hand.

risks_headwinds.claim: Corporate learning was the segment that absorbed the most stress in FY26 and experienced a revenue decline.
risks_headwinds.quote: Corporate learning was the segment that absorbed the most stress in FY’26 and is the segment most clearly turning a corner.

risks_headwinds.claim: FY26 corporate learning revenue closed at INR 96 crores, down 16.5% versus FY25.
risks_headwinds.quote: FY’26 revenue closed at INR 96 crores, down 16.5% versus FY’25.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to expect the Company to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA in FY'27.

management_commitments.claim: For FY28, targets are approximately INR 1,500 crores in revenue and around INR 450 crores in EBITDA.
management_commitments.quote: So, to summarize: for FY’28, the targets are approximately INR 1,500 crores in revenue and around INR 450 crores in EBITDA.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to be the first largest peer-review provider in the industry by volume by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: We are now the second largest peer-review provider in the industry by volume, and we aim to be the first by the end of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management tracks to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27: TRACKING TO COMFORTBALY CROSS INR 300 CRORES IN EBITDA
